mei-you-vs-bu-yong.label: 没有 + verb vs 不用 + verb
recurring_errors: Interpreted 没有上班 as 'didn't have to work' rather than 'didn't work/go to work'.
example_patterns: 没有上班 = did not work/go to work
不用上班 = do not need to work
notes: Review in a later session with different verbs, not just 上班.
2026-09-28: correctly distinguished 没有去 from 不用去, but still read 没有上班 as 'didn't have to work' and 不用上班 as simple 'don't work' in later items.

2026-09-29–30: strong improvement across many mixed sentences; learner usually distinguished 没有 'did not' from 不用 'do not/have to'. Remaining errors were mostly tense/context rather than the core semantic contrast.
2026-10-01–03: distinction remained reliable in mixed sentences.

xiang-modal.label: 想 + verb for desire/intention
recurring_errors: Translated 想去 as a simple future 'am going to' and omitted the desire/intention nuance.
Occasionally rendered 不想 as 'didn't want to' when the sentence had no past-time cue.
example_patterns: 想去 = want to go / would like to go
notes: 2026-09-28: correctly recognized 想/不想 as want to / don't want to in three sentences.
2026-09-29–30: desire meaning is well recognized; current issue is interpreting time reference from context.
2026-10-01–03: 想 consistently recognized as desire/intention; remaining questions concern English tense choice, not 想 itself.

adjective-de-noun.label: Adjective + 的 + noun
recurring_errors: 辣的东西 was not parsed as 'spicy things/food'.
example_patterns: 辣的东西 = spicy things / spicy food
notes: Keep examples concrete and high-frequency.

habitual-time-frequency.label: Habitual time/frequency expressions
recurring_errors: Dropped or misread modifiers such as 每天, 周末, 有时候, 通常, 星期天.
notes: 常常 is currently strong; several neighboring frequency/time words remain shaky.
2026-09-28: 常常 was consistently correct. 有时候 and 通常 were each correct multiple times but were still occasionally swapped. 星期天 improved after one miss.
2026-09-29–30: weekdays and frequency words were mostly correct in varied sentences. One early 通常→sometimes error and one 星期六→Friday mix-up.
2026-10-01–03: frequency expressions remained strong; one 星期五→Wednesday weekday slip occurred on 2026-10-03.

cause-result-suoyi.label: 所以 for cause-result ('so / therefore')
recurring_errors: Interpreted 所以 as 'then' rather than 'so / therefore'.
notes: Review later in a simple cause-result sentence.
2026-09-29–30: 所以 was correctly translated as so/therefore repeatedly; earlier confusion appears largely resolved.
2026-10-01–03: 所以 consistently recognized as so/therefore.

time-reference-from-context.label: Time reference from context rather than verb conjugation
recurring_errors: Rendered 不想去 as 'didn't want to go' when context indicated current/future desire.
Rendered 不用去/不用上班 as past 'didn't have to' when no past-time cue was present.
example_patterns: 昨天没有去 = didn't go yesterday
今天想去 = want to go today
这个星期三不想去 = don't want to go this Wednesday
星期五不用上班 = don't have to work Friday (unless broader context makes Friday past)
notes: Focus on explicit time expressions and discourse context; Mandarin verbs themselves are not conjugated for tense.

2026-10-01–03: major improvement. Learner explicitly identified tense ambiguity when Mandarin lacked a past/future cue and correctly used context such as 昨天/今天早上. A couple of English renderings mixed tenses despite correct Mandarin parsing.

sequence-xian-zai-ranhou-yihou.label: Sequencing with 先…再… / 然后 / 以后
recurring_errors: 先 was unknown on first encounter.
再 was unknown on first encounter.
下班以后 was omitted from two otherwise-correct translations before later being handled correctly.
example_patterns: X 以后 Y = after X, Y
先 X，再 Y = first X, then Y
X，然后 Y = X, then/after that Y
notes: Learner explicitly asked how 然后 differs from 以后 and then applied the distinction correctly.
先…再… was learned quickly after explanation and is now usually recognized correctly.
Continue mixing all three patterns without isolated drilling.
